title: fix(app-shell,i18n): the ObjectView record-count footer reads the singular at one record (objectui#10636)
body:
Fixes #10636
Clause-②: no

## What was wrong

The console `ObjectView` draws a record-count footer (`data-testid="record-count-footer"`) under the list when a record is open beside it in split navigation. It rendered one key, `console.objectView.recordCount`, at every count. There was no singular key and no switch, so `en` read `1 records` at one record. The list view's record-count bar and the record picker's count beside it both pick a `…One` key at exactly one.

In this body COUNT stands for the i18next double-brace count placeholder.

## The change

- **`ObjectView.tsx`, the footer call site only.** `recordCount === 1` picks `console.objectView.recordCountOne`, and every other count picks `console.objectView.recordCount`. This is the two-key switch `ListView` uses for `list.recordCount` / `list.recordCountOne`. A short comment names the switch and the count-label rule.
- **All ten packs gain `console.objectView.recordCountOne`.** Every pack's pair now reads exactly like its `list.recordCount` / `list.recordCountOne` pair, so the footer and the list bar count the same records in the same words:

| pack | `recordCount` before | `recordCount` after | `recordCountOne` (new) |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| en | `COUNT records` | unchanged | `COUNT record` |
| de | `COUNT Datensätze` | unchanged | `COUNT Datensatz` |
| es | `COUNT registros` | unchanged | `COUNT registro` |
| fr | `COUNT enregistrements` | unchanged | `COUNT enregistrement` |
| pt | `COUNT registros` | unchanged | `COUNT registro` |
| ja | `COUNT 件のレコード` | unchanged | same string |
| ko | `COUNT개 레코드` | unchanged | same string |
| zh | `COUNT 条记录` | unchanged | same string |
| ru | `COUNT записей` | `Записей: COUNT` | `COUNT запись` |
| ar | `COUNT سجل` | `عدد السجلات: COUNT` | `COUNT سجل` |

- **ru and ar.** The count-not-one half serves `ru` one (21), few (2-4) and many (5-20), and `ar` zero, two, few (3-10), many (11-99) and other (100+). One noun form is wrong at some of those counts, so the half becomes a count label: a label, a colon, then the number. That is the device ruled on objectui#10024, objectui#10242 and objectui#10425. Each pack's value is the one its `list.recordCount` already reads. The pack comment beside each value says why. There are no `_one` / `_few` / `_two` suffix keys, because `all-locales-key-parity.test.ts` holds every pack to `en`'s key set.
- **ja / ko / zh.** These have one CLDR category (`other`), so both halves are the same string, as their `list.*` pair already is.
- **`objectView-config-keys-retired-4730.test.ts`.** That file pins the namespace's surviving key count and the total of keys it ever held. Its header says a genuinely new key moves both. `recordCountOne` moves the surviving half from 92 to 93 and the total from 210 to 211. The retired list is unchanged. The edit sits inside the claim's `tests` surface. It is required because the new key is inside the pinned namespace, and it touches only the two constants and their comments.
- **`.changeset/10636-objectview-record-count-singular.md`**: `'@object-ui/app-shell': patch` and `'@object-ui/i18n': patch`.

## Premise and hypothesis readings (base `f99f9cde7`)

- **H1, holds.** The pin below mounts the real `ObjectView` and reads the footer. On the base it read `1 records` at `en` 1. The control at `en` 3 read `3 records`.
- **H2, holds.** Every pack's `list.recordCount` / `list.recordCountOne` was read and mirrored. None of the ten `console.objectView.recordCount` values was a count label before this change. `ru` held the `many` noun form (the old `list.recordCount` value). `ar` held the singular noun `سجل` at every count, which differs even from the old `list.recordCount` plural. The CLDR categories were measured per pack with `Intl.PluralRules`. `en` and `de` have one/other. `es`, `fr` and `pt` add `many`, reached only from a million up. `ja`, `ko` and `zh` have `other` only. `ru` has four categories and `ar` has six, so only those two needed the count label.
- **H3, holds.** The directory holds exactly the ten packs. The key-parity test passes, and so does `check:i18n-keys`.
- **H5, measured.** `git grep -l -E "recordCount|record-count-footer|1 records"` over `.changeset`, `content/docs` and `packages/*/README.md` hits four files. `.changeset/10425-ru-ar-count-labels.md` describes the seven values that change carried, and it stays true. `.changeset/6888-location-residue-refusal-keyed.md` names the `lookup` pair only. `.changeset/issue-8875-cite-by-content-convention.md` matches `1 records` inside `#11 records`. `packages/plugin-report/README.md` names a report result field. None names this footer or this key, so there is no dated note and no frontmatter change. Control: `recordCountOne` over `.changeset` hits the 6888 changeset.

## Pins: red on the base, green on the head

New file: `packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.recordCountFooter-10636.test.tsx`. It mounts the real `ObjectView` in split navigation, with `?recordId=` in the URL as a row click writes it, inside a real i18next instance booted in the language under test. `t` is not mocked. The count is the `total` from the view's own count query. Rows:

- The footer at `en` 1 and 3 (the control), `ru` 1 / 2 / 21 and `ar` 1 / 2 / 11. The `Intl.PluralRules` categories of those counts are asserted.
- The shipped defect by name: `en` at 1 does not read `1 records`.
- Pack level: every pack's pair equals its `list.recordCount` pair, and `ru` / `ar` `recordCount` end in a colon and the count, and differ from their One half.

**Red.** The pin was committed alone first (`1a5581bca`) and run on the unmodified code and packs: `Tests 9 failed | 3 passed (12)`. `en` at 1 read `1 records`. `ru` read `1 записей`, `2 записей` and `21 записей`. `ar` read `2 سجل` and `11 سجل`. The pack-level rows failed on the missing key. The 3 that passed were `en` at 3 (the control), `ar` at 1 (the old value happens to be right at one) and the CLDR row.

**Green.** At head `f284c382f`, the pin runs inside the union below and all 12 pass.

**Ablations** ran at `1360eddf4`, with the fix committed, through objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`. Each proves the mutation landed on disk (anchor x1 to x0, blob changed) and then proves the restore (blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty). The pin resolves `@object-ui/i18n` through the vitest alias to `packages/i18n/src`, and `ObjectView` by relative import, so no `dist` is involved.

- **A: the call-site switch.** The ternary was put back to the one-key call. Result: `4 failed | 8 passed`. The failures were `en` at 1 (`1 records`), `ru` at 1 (`Записей: 1`), `ar` at 1 (`عدد السجلات: 1`) and the named-defect row. All count-not-one rows and pack rows stayed green.
- **B: the ru / ar values.** Both `recordCount` values went back to the base noun forms, one ablation nested inside the other. Result: `6 failed | 6 passed`. The failures were `ru` 2 / 21, `ar` 2 / 11, the list-bar parity row and the count-invariance row. The singular rows stayed green.

## Local verification at head `f284c382f`

objectui has no `dispatch-gates.mjs`, so the families were picked by hand from the root `package.json` and `.github/workflows/`. Exit codes were captured before any pipe.

- **Tests**, from the repo root through the verify lock: `vitest run` over 148 files: the whole of `packages/i18n` (71 test files); every test outside it whose source names `builtInLocales` or a locale-pack path; every `ObjectView*` test in `packages/app-shell/src/views`; `defaults-maps-mirror-en-pack`; and `scripts/__tests__/check-i18n-*`. Result: `Test Files 148 passed (148)`, `Tests 2648 passed (2648)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`. The same union at `1360eddf4` found the 4730 count red (`expected … to have a length of 92 but got 93`), and the third commit updates that pin.
- **Build and type-check**: `turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/app-shell^... --concurrency=2` gave `Tasks: 28 successful, 28 total`. Then `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n run type-check` and `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` (each `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`) both exited 0. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFilesOnly` lists the new pin (1 of 4650 files for app-shell) and the 4730 test and `ru.ts` for i18n.
- **Gates**, all exit 0:
  - `pnpm check:i18n-keys`: every in-scope call-site key resolves against the en pack.
  - `pnpm check:i18n-drift`: `0 en value(s) changed (1 key(s) added, 0 removed …)`.
  - `pnpm check:i18n-dead-keys`: a report. The new key is not listed.
  - `pnpm check:i18n-designer-parity`.
  - `pnpm check:control-bytes`: `OK (scanned 8767 tracked text file(s); skipped 85 binary)`. The changed files were also self-scanned for control bytes, with 0 hits.
  - `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: `VERDICT new-cross-file-line-citations: 0 new citation(s)`.
  - `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: `13 source file(s) of 2 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)`.
  - `pnpm changeset:check`, `check-changeset-overwrite`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape` and `check:test-path-roots`.
  - `pnpm check:changeset-claims` is report-only. It names three pending changesets that mention a touched file: `4730-objectview-config-keys-retired.md` (the pin file this change edits; see Acceptance notes), `6661-app-launcher-nav-menu-renderers.md` (`en.ts`, about `console.nav` strings) and `7070-no-invented-gantt-date-fields.md` (`ObjectView.tsx`, about the gantt options). All three were re-read, and this change does not touch what any of them says.
  - `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` over the changed paths: `NOT GOVERNED`.
- **ESLint** was narrowed rather than run repo-wide. The measurement has three parts. ① Population: both packages lint with `eslint .` under the root `eslint.config.js`, and `--print-config` resolves a rule set for each changed file. ② Count, from `--no-inline-config --format json`: 13 files, 0 errors. All 172 warnings are in `ObjectView.tsx`, and the base file gives exactly 172 under the same flags. ③ Invariance: `--print-config` shows no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService` on any changed file, so linting is not type-aware and this diff cannot move the verdict of any untouched file.
- **Doc gates**: the diff touches no `README.md`, `content/docs/**` or `docs/**` file.
- **Serial constraints**: `git merge-tree` of this head against `origin/main` `c659439b4` exited 0, and against objectui#10635's branch `claude/issue-10580-refresh-indicator-translated-name` `1a89050c2` exited 0. `main` has not moved in any file this change touches, so no merge was made (as of `c659439b4`; objectui#10635 has since merged into the ten packs, and a merge-tree against `ed8251189` is clean).
- CI had not concluded when this was opened. The seat reads it.

## Acceptance notes

- `fr` and `pt` put 0 in CLDR `one`, but the switch gives them the plural at 0. The same holds for their `list.*` pair, and PR objectui#10240's review recorded it as true and outside that card. It is left as it is.
- The pending `.changeset/4730-objectview-config-keys-retired.md` says the namespace held 209 keys and that 93 live keys stay. Both are statements about that change's own diff, and later changes had already moved the live count, so it is left as it is.
